bullets.text: AI Art Not Copyrightable - **US Supreme Court** declines to review ruling on AI-generated art copyright.
Apple's Age Verification Bug - **Apple** clarifies UK age verification prompt in iOS 26.4 beta was an error.
Spotify's Audiobook Charts - **Spotify** launches new discovery feature for audiobooks in the UK and US.
Cursor's Revenue Surge - **Cursor** surpasses $2 billion in annualized revenue amid rising competition.
ChatGPT Uninstalls Spike - **ChatGPT** app uninstalls surged 295% after news of **OpenAI**'s DoD deal.
Stripe's AI Cost Solution - **Stripe** introduces feature to help AI startups manage costs and profit margins.
PayPay's IPO Delayed - **PayPay** postpones U.S. IPO amid geopolitical tensions and market volatility.
Tech Workers Support Anthropic - Tech workers urge the DoD to withdraw **Anthropic**'s supply-chain risk designation.
Nvidia's $4B Investment - **Nvidia** invests $4 billion in photonics to enhance AI data center capabilities.
MyFitnessPal Acquires Cal AI - **MyFitnessPal** acquires **Cal AI**, a viral calorie counting app developed by teens.
